WITH project_ratios AS (
  SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id,
         p.fundflux AS funding_source,
         AVG(1.0 * s.boxx / s.boxz) AS ratio
  FROM projects AS p
  JOIN scanspatial AS s
    ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
  WHERE s.boxx IS NOT NULL
    AND s.boxz IS NOT NULL
    AND s.boxz <> 0
  GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux
), margins AS (
  SELECT project_id,
         funding_source,
         ratio,
         ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS margin
  FROM project_ratios
)
SELECT project_id,
       funding_source,
       ratio,
       margin
FROM margins
ORDER BY margin DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
